stick.hat.trim.name: Trim hat
stick.hat.trim.note: trim hat with NOSE DOWN / LWD / NOSE UP markings on top of the head

stick.weapon_release.name: Weapon release
stick.weapon_release.note: red pickle button on the top left of the head

stick.pinky.lever.name: Pinky lever
stick.pinky.lever.note: long lever at the lower front of the grip (paddle / analog brake lever)

unplaced.stick.hat.tms: knurled 4-way switch behind the pickle (F-16 TMS position); could also be DMS
unplaced.stick.hat.dms: round 4-way hat on the left rear of the head; which F-16 hat it is is not verified
unplaced.stick.hat.cms: 4-way hat low on the left side of the grip (owners report the CMS sits low on the F-16EX); not verified
unplaced.stick.trigger: under the head on the front of the grip, hidden (only a red edge shows below the left extension)
unplaced.stick.gimbal: the photo shows the grip only; the gimbal is in the Rhino base

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), the WinWing F-16EX grip alone (no base) seen from the pilot's left side, slightly from above; front of the grip to the left
mappingSource: catalog vpforce.json (source https://docs.vpforce.eu/products/grip-adapters/): control names only, no input numbers (Rhino numbering set by the Configurator); identities from the grip's F-16 layout: trim hat printed NOSE DOWN/LWD/NOSE UP, red pickle = weapon release, lower front lever = paddle/analog brake lever; WinWing publishes no reachable control drawing for the F-16EX (HeliSimmer review https://www.helisimmer.com/reviews/winwing-f-16ex-joystick-grip-hotas-orion-2-base lists 4x 4-way+push hats, one 8-way+push hat, two buttons, top and bottom levers plus a removable left-side extension with two more hats)
note: The F-16EX has more thumb hats than an F-16 grip (the left-side extension adds a hat and a mini-stick), so which hat is TMS, DMS or CMS cannot be told from the photo -> TMS/DMS/CMS are candidates only. The trigger sits under the head on the front and is hidden (only a red edge shows). The photo shows the grip only, so the gimbal is not marked.
